Commentary.Commentary: First match of the World Cup, South Africa vs Sri Lanka and the home team lost. Eyebrows were raised as to where this will lead them to. Fast forward around 15 days later and they are gearing up to face Australia in their first ever finals. Unscripted. Do join us for the mega event on 26TH FEBRUARY AT 6.30 PM IST (1 PM GMT) and earlier for the build up. Cheers!

Sune Luus says England played really well but the game but her bowlers bowled well. Applauds the performance of Ayabonga Khaka. Shares they have made history and hopes this is a turning point in sports in general in South Africa. Ends by thanking the crowd for the support. Says she is happy for the team as they play the final for the first time.

Heather Knight says they are gutted. Applauds how South Africa Women played and feels the pressure to big in the end. Hopes to comeback stronger in the future. Reckons they have huge talent but fine margins play a huge role against such big teams. Feels she was listening to the crowd and is happy where Women's cricket is going.

Tazmin Brits is the Player of the Match. She says they dream about this kind of match and thanks the crowd for their incredible support. Adds she understood the pitch well. Reckons they were looking for a score around 150. Tells she is happy with the way she fielded. Feels they are proud for this opportunity and are looking forward to the finals.
...Presentation coming up...

Sciver though held the key and England were favourites when she was batting but once she fell, wickets fell in a heap. It was all onto Knight. She tried her level best but it is the hosts who came out on top. If you can point out one thing which keep South Africa in the chase, it was their fielding. In these two knockout games, hands down, the hosts were brilliant of all and that is a big reason they are going to the finals. Everyone on their bowling side bowled superbly.

England will be disappointed they could not chase this down. They batted brilliantly in the Powerplay courtesy Danni Wyatt and Sophia Dunkley. However, Shabnim Ismail got her side back with a double wicket over. A special thanks to the fielding by Tazmin Brits. Runs though came quickly despite the two wickets. Danni and Sciver put up another good stand and got the chase back on track. Once Danni fell, things changed, runs were hard to come by and except for Sciver, the others struggled.

That is a brilliant comeback from South Africa. What a win, what a morale boosting win for them to storm into the finals. It is England who beat them in the 50-over World Cup sometime ago and they have got their revenge, brilliantly. Absolute scenes at Cape Town.
SOUTH AFRICA ARE GOING TO THE FINALS! What scenes at the ground! Full and on off, Glenn lofts it to mid on where it falls safely. Shabnim Ismail in in tears. What a performance.
Full ball, outside off, Glenn hits in the air to mid off where the ball falls safely. Glenn loses her bat at the other end as she runs across.
Length ball on off, Dean paddles only to short fine leg for one. 11 runs 2 balls.

OUT! TIMBER! That should be the ticket to the finals. Length ball on leg, no pace again. Knight tries to heave but misses and the ball hits the timber. 12 runs 3 balls. The crowd is jumping right now.
DOT BALL! Length ball, slow and outside off. Knight steps across and tries to use the pace but there was nothing on the ball. It falls on the deck.
On middle, hit to long on for a single. Can the England captain deliver? Does she have in her.
Shabnim Ismail to bowl the final over.
Glenn will keep the strike for the last over. 13 runs needed. Full and on off, heaved to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on off, Glenn miscues her heave in the air and it falls freely in the mid-wicket region for two.
Length and outside off, cut past point for a single.
SIX! The skipper is keeping the hopes alive. She is the only hope. Knight reads the slow ball and waits before hitting this full ball over long on for a six.
Bye! Slower ball, full and on leg. Glenn fails to hit and the batters takes a quick bye.
This is full and on leg, swept to square leg for a single.

OUT! LBW! England are falling apart. Brunt walks back but just when the clock nears the end, she reviews. No bat clearly. THREE REDS and Brunt continues her walk. The pitch is getting tired and so are England. This is full and angling on off. Brunt takes a step forward to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. That was dead in front. Knight just wanted to check her luck but no avail.

OUT! TAKEN! Second wicket in the over! South Africa Women believe now. This is full and on middle, no pace and Ecclestone tries to generate but not much as she swings her bat to go over covers. Just gets height and Anne Bosch takes another catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Anne Bosch b Ayabonga Khaka

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, eased to long on for one. Runs first one hard and have to settle with it.
This is full and outside off. Knight gets low to sweep but misses. Pressure on Knight.
Wide! Length and down leg, Knight looks to sweep but misses.
This is full and on middle, Ecclestone lofts it through the bowler to long on for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Jones goes and the pressure is piling on England! This is full and way outside off, there to be hit and Jones tries to smash over covers but toe ends and Anne Bosch takes a sharp catch there. England Women need 28 runs in 17 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Anne Bosch b Ayabonga Khaka

Commentary.Commentary: Full toss again, Jone smashes it to long on for a single.
On the pads, pulled to deep square leg for a single.
This is full and on middle, whipped to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
A full toss on off, worked to long on for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! South Africa Women again get some control over the game. An off-cutter, full and outside off. Sciver tries to go over long on but fails to power and who else but it goes to Tazmin Brits who takes a simple catch. 33 runs needed in 22 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Tazmin Brits b Nadine de Klerk

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, nudged to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! What an over for England! 14 off it. Another one like this and they will be in the driving seat. A slower ball on the pads and it is whipped away to deep square leg for four.
A slower bumper on middle, this is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
This is full and very close to the leg pole. Sciver makes room to drive but misses. An error from the keeper gives away a single.
Length ball, outside off, Sciver chips it to mid off.
FOUR! Sciver is targeting their main bowler. This one is down the leg side.  Sciver helps it on its way to fine leg for four more.
FOUR! Perfect start to the over! Length ball on middle. Sciver steps across and plays the paddle scoop over fine leg for a boundary.
Short in length and on middle, Sciver plays it to square leg for one.
This is full and on middle. Sciver sweeps it behind square leg for a couple.
On off, pushed to cover for one.
Length and on off, bunted to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Well played! Full and outside off, Sciver makes room and finds gap through covers for a boundary.
Shorter and on off, Knight pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, eased to long on for a single.
A slower full ball, outside off, Knight waits to drive but misses.
Length and on off, dragged to mid-wicket for one.
Full and on off, Sciver whips it to deep mid-wicket. Kapp does well there. Two.
Too full and outside off, Sciver drives but finds the fielder at cover.
Outside off, driven through point for a single.
Was that a chance? Full and outside off. Sciver skips down and drives on the up the left of the bowler who flies and gets both hands on it but parries it to mid off. It was a chance. Dropped.

OUT! LBW! Only Chloe Tryon was interested in this one and the umpire agreed with her. Sciver takes the review though. Flat and on leg, Sciver looks to sweep but the replay shows there was gloves on it. That is why she reviewed it instantly.
A single as this is hit to cover.
SIX! That is pressure releasing shot! Full and outside off. Knight comes down the track and extends her arms to go over long off for a six.
This is full and outside off, Knight reverse sweeps it past short third man but the fielder gives a  chase and keeps it down to two.
An arm ball on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
A single to end the over! On off, played to long off for a single.
Around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Leg bye! On the pads. Sciver mistimes her pull and it rolls to the left of the keeper for a single.
Length ball on middle, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.
What a mix-up! On off, Knight drops it to cover and Sciver is on her way for a single but is sent back. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. That could have been close.
Length and on off, Knight taps it to cover.
Full and on middle. Knight works it to long on for a single.
Another single as this is hit to long on.
Too full and on middle, Knight plays it to long on for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! Wyatt goes now and South Africa are right in this game. Short of a length and tailing on the hips, Wyatt pulls but unconvincingly to short fine leg where Tazmin Brits takes it to her left. South Africa Women have been just superb on the field.
Commentary.Howout: c Tazmin Brits b Ayabonga Khaka

Commentary.Commentary: On off, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Length and outside off, guided to short third man.
Another dot to end! On off, Danni plays it to point.
Shorter and around off, this is cut to point.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Shorter and outside off, Danni Wyatt cuts it through point for one.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, this one stays low. Natalie Sciver looks to cut but misses.
On off, this is timed but to covers.
Shorter and outside off, Danni looks to cut but misses.
Angled into the pads, Danni Wyatt flicks it but to mid-wicket.
Another single as this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Up and over! Danni Wyatt steps out and lofts it over cover. The long off fielder runs to her left, dives but fails to stop it.
Shorter and outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled down to fine leg for one.
Good length and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
FOUR! Up and over! Natalie Sciver powers it. On middle, fuller, this is lofted over the mid on fielder and it races away to the fence.
Two more! Angled into the pads, this is clipped through square leg for two.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Two boundaries in the over. Runs continue to flow! Fuller and on the pads, this is clipped through square leg and it races away to the fence.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled but to square leg.
FOUR! Just over! Fuller and on middle, Danni Wyatt lofts it over mid on and it races away to the fence.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, this is guided past point for two.
BEATEN! End of a top over from Shabnim Ismail! Shorter and on the body, Natalie Sciver bails out.
Two! A yorker on middle, this is worked through square leg for two.
Angled into the pads, this is worked to square leg.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a stunner, an absolute stunner! Tazmin Brits can do no wrong. That is a screamer of a catch. A short one on middle, Alice Capsey looks to pull, she tries to do so in an awkward position, it goes off the splice towards mid-wicket. Tazmin Brits runs to her right, dives with one hand stretched out and takes it inches above the ground. Two in quick succession. The hosts back into this one.
Commentary.Howout: c Tazmin Brits b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and on off, defended.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, a wicket for South Africa. The crowd here finds its voice back. A welcome wicket as the two were taking the game away. On middle, a slower one. Sophia Dunkley looks to heave it over the mid-wicket fielder but it goes off the toe-end and Tazmin Brits takes an easy catch. They need a couple more quickly.
Commentary.Howout: c Tazmin Brits b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on middle, Sophia lobs it towards mid off for one.
Inside edge! On middle, Sophia Dunkley looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Over the leg side now. Out comes the slog sweep and it is nailed over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence. England running away with the game now.
FOUR! Two in a row. Raining boundaries at the moment! This is tossed up again, it is hit over mid off and into the fence.
FOUR! Up and over! Sophia Dunkley steps out and then lofts it over the mid off fielder for another boundary.
On middle, defended.
FOUR! Just wide! Runs flowing! Outside off, Danni Wyatt slashes, it goes past the diving fielder at point and into the fence.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
FOUR! That is nicely played! Shorter and outside off, Sophia Dunkley waits and then guides it downt to the third man fence for a boundary.
Shorter and outside off, Dunkley looks to cut but misses.
A single as this is guided down to third man.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Fuller and outside off, Sophia Dunkley looks to jam it out but it goes off the toe-end past the diving keeper and down to the third man fence.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed towards mid on for one.
Fuller and angled into the pads, Danni Wyatt looks to heave it on the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads.
Shorter and around off, Danni Wyatt guides it to point.

FOUR! Top effort from Shabnim Ismail but in vain! On off, this is lofted just over the cover fielder. Shabnim Ismail gives it a chase and then dives forward and tries to push it back in but touches the ropes in the process.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket for no runs.
On off, this is guided down to third man for one.

FOUR BYES! Sloppy from South Africa again. They have not begun all that well in the field! A good bumper, Danni Wyatt sways out of the way. The keeper dives to her left but fails to stop it cleanly and a boundary results.
BEATEN! Shorter and outside off, Danni Wyatt looks to cut but is beaten.
That is a superb stop! Fuller and on off, this is driven back past the bowler, the fielder at mid off, runs to her right, dives and stops it.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! England off to a flier here. On middle, this is hit hard towards mid on. The fielder is late in getting down, it hits her leg and then goes down to the long on fence.
A loud shout but turned down! Full and on the pads, Sophia Dunkley looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Going down leg.
On off, this is pushed down to long on for one. End of a good first over for England Women!
Nonkululeko Mlaba gets away with one! On the pads, this is swept hard but to short fine leg.
NOT OUT! Sophia Dunkley is in! On off, this is pushed towards cover and the batters take off. The fielder hits the stumps at the keeper's end but replays show that Sophia Dunkley is in.
Run out appeal and it is referred. Sophia Dunkley seems in but direct hits are always close.
FIVE WIDES! Bonus runs! Down the leg side. Danni Wyatt steps out and looks to pull but misses. The keeper fails to collect it and it goes down to the fine leg fence.
Slower through the air and around off, this is guided to point.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Danni Wyatt and England Women are underway! On the pads, Danni plays the sweep, it goes over the short fine leg fielder and into the fence.
On middle, this is defended.
